replies.author: Doppelganger_
replies.body:
Some feedback (just my opinions

  • Can you please post a picture of the starting inventory. Make sure not to have too many blocks
  • You might want to look at lag factors because of the amount of fences and glowstone. Especially for people with not so strong computers
  • I feel the lanes are a bit thin
  • I don't think it is in the best interest to have this island and the opposite on the other side jumpable from the main playing field. This makes wall running and tunnelling too easy as they don't have to reveal themselves for long.
  • Also on that note it might be wise to have a bedrock wall in the ground somewhere in front of the woolrooms so tunnellers have to surface to get to the wool room and to give the defenders a better chance
  • You might want to add some sort of height and left/right limit in the yml if you want if you feel its necessary
  •  I feel that 30 v 30 maybe a bit too much but I will elaborate on that once I you put up a download. The picture's perspective skews with the size of the map.
